correctness.rationale: A 24-vertex S4 Cayley graph with three adjacent-transposition generators has 36 edges and exactly 14 facial cycles (six squares, eight hexagons). Recursive least-uncovered-vertex enumeration lists all 169 perfect matchings; a facial XOR mask gives all legal flips. Complete BFS from each of 169 matchings yields a connected all-face graph with 460 edges, radius 7, diameter 9, exact eccentricity and distance distributions. All 790244 unordered matching triples were tested by intersecting three exact shortest-path intervals: 79828 none, 700774 one, 9642 two medians. Omitting each of the 14 faces gives connected plane flip graphs, with square omission 410 edges/radius 11/diameter 22, hexagon 440/11/21; two geometric enumerations and an additional independent implementation confirm values. This is exhaustive finite graph certification, not extrapolation.

evidence: Wang–Kang 2026 establishes medianity for proper face subsets (when connected), covering qualitative punctured medianity.
Lam–Zhang and Zhang–Yang–Yao describe conventional bounded-face resonance graphs.
Turaev treats more general even-cycle glidings.
broader_coverage.reasoning: None of these qualitative/broader results supplies exact face-specific distances, spherical nonmedian triple or all-triplet median counts.
